Evidence, with limits. This detector can misclassify real and generated images, especially new generators, edits, and compressed files. The score is a model output, not a calibrated probability. Missing provenance is not evidence of authenticity.

About the detector

Uses Effort CLIP-L/14, trained on GenImage and converted to int8 for browser use. Our test on one known OpenAI-generated image gave 90.0% after conversion, compared with 99.7% in Python. This is not an accuracy benchmark. Compression and quantization can change results, and photo controls can give false positives. Scores below 20% or above 80% receive directional labels; these are interface thresholds, not validated operating points. This version does not verify Content Credentials or identify a specific generator.

For noncommercial experimentation under the model's CC BY-NC 4.0 license. The first run downloads about 294 MB, which the browser tries to cache. Analysis can be slow and memory-intensive; use a desktop browser. Images stay on your device. No paid detection API is required.
